record.question: The topical semi-solid dosage form which contains 50% solid material is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Paste. A paste is a stiff semisolid preparation containing a high proportion of solids, commonly around 20–50%; 50% solids is the paste choice. Source/context note: The precise percentage ranges vary across pharmaceutics references and formulation definitions. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562209/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
